terms.comment: Andresian’s diminutive on lībum, a cake, after lucunculus; not in Lewis & Short. Morgan–Owens puts muffin and cupcake under one heading.

Traupman’s “muffin”. Classically it is a cheese tart (Cato Agr. 78; Plautus; Petronius), and it is our word for a tart (see “tart”), so a muffin is better kept apart from it. Morgan–Owens uses it for pizza.
terms.gloss: Traupman’s word for a muffin; classically a tart

sources: Lewis & Short: scriblita
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 72.
